relationships.subject: roflumilast
relationships.evidence_quote: Using these in vitro models, we demonstrated that pan-PDE4 inhibition using roflumilast significantly promoted differentiation of Schwann cells towards a myelinating phenotype, as indicated by the upregulation of myelin proteins, including MBP and MAG.

relationships.subject: roflumilast
relationships.evidence_quote: we assessed the differentiation of primary rat Schwann cells exposed in vitro to the PDE4 inhibitor roflumilast

key_findings: Roflumilast promoted Schwann cell differentiation and upregulated MBP and MAG in 2D and 3D models.
Roflumilast-treated Schwann cells enhanced iPSC nociceptor axonal outgrowth and accelerated myelination.
